instruction: An intimate portrait photograph of two women in a medium close-up shot against a solid, light blue studio background. On the right, the woman with dark curly hair (R1) stands with her back turned to the camera, wearing a light blue-grey strap top. Leaning against her from the left is the woman with straight dark hair (R2), who wears a light pink strap top. The woman with straight dark hair (R2) rests her head and the side of her right hand tenderly against the shoulder of the woman with dark curly hair (R1), looking directly toward the camera with a soft, subtle smile. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused lighting from the front-left, casting gentle shadows and highlighting natural skin textures against the cool blue backdrop.
elements: R2 leans against R1 rather than R1 leaning against R2
R2 rests her head on R1's shoulder rather than R1 resting her head on R2
R2 places the side of her right hand against R1's shoulder rather than R1 placing her hand on R2's shoulder
R1 is turned away from the camera while serving as the shoulder contact for R2
